// diagnostic E2406

Jet.OrphanErrorConversion

Can't declare `impl {target}.From({source})` — neither type is defined in this program.

What

Can't declare `impl {target}.From({source})` — neither type is defined in this program.

Why

Typed-target error conversions obey the same orphan rule as trait impls; only the default `Err` target may name a foreign source.

Fix

Define one of these types locally, or convert the foreign source into `Err`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.OrphanErrorConversion: Tests/UI/e2406_orphan_error_conv.stderr.
